attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Maryland state corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Filing Requirement Check Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence get apportionment.state_code get "MD" eq and
apportionment.has_economic_nexus get apportionment.state_code get "MD" eq and

action_details.action_postfix:
"Maryland filing required due to physical presence (office, employees, or property in state)." job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Comptroller of Maryland Publication 19 (Corporation Income Tax Guide)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-402 (Filing requirements)" job.audit_trail swap addto

"Maryland filing required due to economic nexus (post-Wayfair)." job.audit_trail swap addto
"Threshold: $100,000 gross receipts in Maryland" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: South Dakota v. Wayfair, Inc., 138 S. Ct. 2080 (2018)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-101 (Economic nexus provisions)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No Maryland nexus - no filing requirement. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland Income Adjustments Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_postfix:
0.0 /additions xdef
additions /apportionment.state_additions xdef
0.0 /subtractions xdef
subtractions /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"Maryland state-specific income adjustments to federal taxable income calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto
"Additions may include: Interest on U.S. government obligations, IRC Section 199A qualified business income deduction, Bonus depreciation (MD decouples from federal accelerated depreciation), State tax refunds" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Subtractions may include: Interest on Maryland and other state/municipal bonds, State income taxes paid, Maryland NOL deduction (subject to limitations)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Form 500 Instructions (Schedule of Income Modifications)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-306 (Additions to federal taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-307 (Subtractions from federal taxable income)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_additions xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_subtractions xdef
"No nexus - no state adjustments calculated." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Maryland state corporate income tax. Applies MD 8.25% flat tax rate to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

initial_action.action_postfix: "Maryland State Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Calculate MD tax at 8.25% flat rate
action_details.action_postfix:
apportionment.state_taxable_income get result.md_corp_tax_rate get mul /md_state_tax xdef
md_state_tax apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /apportionment.state_tax xdef
apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"Maryland state corporate income tax calculation:" job.audit_trail swap addto
"1. Federal taxable income: [Form 1120 line 28]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"2. Apportioned to MD: × [Apportionment % using single-sales factor]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"3. State additions: + [Additions per MD Tax-General Code § 10-306]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"4. State subtractions: - [Subtractions per MD Tax-General Code § 10-307]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"5. MD taxable income: = [Result]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"6. MD tax rate: × 8.25%" job.audit_trail swap addto
"7. MD income tax: = [Tax before credits]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"8. MD credits: - [Credits (R&D, job creation, biotechnology, etc.)]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"9. MD tax liability: = [Final tax]" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Form 500 (Corporation Income Tax Return) Instructions" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Comptroller Publication 19 (Corporation Income Tax Guide)" job.audit_trail swap addto
"Reference: MD Tax-General Code § 10-105 (Tax rate: 8.25%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef
"No Maryland nexus - no tax liability. Any estimated payments are refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto
